description: This file defines the Factorial class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing mathematical functions related to factorial computations such as factorial, double factorial, and multinomial functions.

classes.name: Factorial
classes.description: Provides static methods for calculating factorial, double factorial, and multinomial computations.

methods.name: fact
methods.description: Calculates the factorial of a number or an array of numbers, handling non-integer and edge cases appropriately.

methods.name: factDouble
methods.description: Calculates the double factorial of a number or an array of numbers.

methods.name: multinomial
methods.description: Calculates the multinomial coefficient for a set of input values.
